upstream.description: A multi-model local AI Voice Generator (TTS) studio. An open-source alternative to ElevenLabs and expensive online voice generators.

classification.analysis: Voice Studio is a local web app (FastAPI backend, React/TypeScript frontend) for text-to-speech with seven switchable open models: VibeVoice, Kokoro, Kitten TTS, Chatterbox, OmniVoice, VoxCPM2 and Qwen3-TTS. It offers a multi-speaker podcast editor, voice cloning, Whisper transcription with SRT/VTT export, offline translation and voice-to-voice dubbing. Everything runs offline on GPU, CPU or MPS, with isolated virtualenvs for incompatible engines. Aimed at creators wanting an open-source ElevenLabs alternative.

use_cases.title: Generate a multi-speaker podcast from a script locally
Clone a voice from a short reference clip
Transcribe audio to an editable transcript and SRT subtitles
Dub a clip into another language and voice offline
Compare several open TTS engines behind one UI
